artistic_choices: Horse-sized white dog c01 with moving snowfall c02 gives awe; peaceful flock protector c05, never an evil attacking wolf.
Four paws, two dog ears, one tail, thick wet white dog coat; editorial long-haired livestock guardian type without claiming breed.

prompt: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Nonell de la neu, peaceful snow giant transformed into a GREAT WHITE DOG THE SIZE OF A HORSE. ANATOMY: ONE living huge white DOG, one broad dog head, two dark attentive eyes, two natural folded dog ears, FOUR sturdy canine legs and paws, ONE long white tail. Thick coarse white dog fur, clear dog muzzle; no antlers, horns, wings or human features [nonell-de-la-neu-c01]. MOMENT: STRIDE powerfully through the FIRST SNOW toward low viewer, front paw reaching past a foreground snow-covered stone, head raised with solemn protective alertness. Snow comes with him: a dense bank of falling physical snow sweeps behind and along his moving body and settles over the ground as he passes [c02]. Behind his horse-sized shoulders, three much smaller sheep with simple bells shelter together peacefully, protected by him [c05]. POWER: brings snow from place to place, guards flocks, no attack, growling hostility, fangs display, beam or luminous aura [c02,c05]. SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low camera near huge forward paw; body fills the square; small sheep behind at nearly same depth unmistakably establish HORSE-SIZE, not an ordinary sheepdog. LIGHT & WEATHER: one cold moonlight opening above first-snow cloud, luminous white fur rim against deep charcoal sky and dark brown rocks; dense ordinary snowfall, strong contrast. SURFACE: rough white fur clumped with snow, cold damp nose, weathered rocks, textured fleece. SETTING: high snowy Catalan pastoral country, dark mountain slope secondary. MOOD: noble awe-inspiring colossal guardian, overwhelming protective presence, never evil, cute pet, calm animal postcard or cartoon. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, letters, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads or limbs; no design borrowed from film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, runes or energy ribbons. Rich painterly natural surfaces, high contrast, strong subject silhouette at 200 pixels.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native 1254px and 200px inspected: one great white horse-size dog with one head, two eyes, two folded ears, one tail and natural quadruped stride (c01); rear legs partly occluded by body and snowfall. Three small bell-wearing sheep behind demonstrate protective role c05 and scale. Noble raised head and huge forward paw dominate 200px, first snow moving and settling around his passage c02, no attack or evil expression. No extra limbs, magical aura, symbols, text, gore or borrowed design. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and head, forepaw and sheep crops. One great white dog the size of a horse (nonell-de-la-neu-c01). It has one broad head, two eyes, two folded ears, a dark nose, a closed muzzle, and a thick coarse white coat clotted with snow. One tail sweeps at the left. One huge forepaw reaches past a snowy foreground rock toward a very low camera; the other legs are hidden by the body and the snow, with no extras. Three sheep wearing bells shelter behind his forelegs (the flocks' bells, c05), each with one head and two ears. Their heads reach only to his elbow, which establishes the horse-size scale. A dense first snowfall swirls around him and settles where he passes (he brings the snow, c02) on a moonlit, snowy mountain slope. His expression is solemn and watchful, not aggressive. As §6.5 asks for benevolent beings, he is a peaceful protector (c05) who inspires awe rather than hostility. No aura, text or gore. At 200px the looming white mass over the small sheep reads as a colossal snow guardian, not an ordinary sheepdog.
